content:
Adds or updates resource links for the specified customer account.
Requires the Basic [16] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
Example: 3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6
The UUID of the customer account you want to add resource links for.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
required
Array [
string
The name of the resource.
string
The URL of the resource.
]
